text:
jess: Heads-up — planning to publish py/ts SDK 1.8.0 canary now. This will start the deprecation runway for the legacy sync client (GA deprecations later). Need a quick check on dist-tag-pin strategy, release notes, and rollback criteria. Change window tonight 23:00 PT. Any objections?

deploy-bot: publish-check: canary artifacts uploaded to staging registry. smoke-tests queued. docs-bot: changelog draft created at https://git.redwood/changelogs/sdk/1.8.0-draft (placeholder).

sam: +1 on canary. Proposal: pin stable -> 1.7.x for 48h after canary. Do not auto-flip dist-tag on artifact push unless smoke-tests + canary pass. :thumbsup:

nate: Builds are green on CI. Wheels and tarballs in staging, checksums: sha256:abc123... Signed artifacts ready to push during cutover.

dave: Rollback criteria? If things go sideways do we yank the dist-tag or publish a rollback patch? Need thresholds so oncall knows when to revert.

jess: Good q. Quick rules: if <=1% error and no auth/data loss, we can push a patch. If >1% API error rate sustained for 2 consecutive hours or any data-corrupting bug, yank canary and revert dist-tag to 1.7.x immediately. Documented in release playbook.

emily: Security scan: no high severity vuln. One minor dep in TS requires pinning (axios -> 0.27.2). I'll open a PR to pin that in the canary branch and coordinate quick rebuild.

sam: Deploy plan: deploy-bot will shadow traffic for 10m, then route 10% traffic for 30m, collecting latency/errors. If any automated checks fail, auto-fallback to 1.7.x. We'll keep a 'deprecated-sync' documentation tag for customers who need the old sync path.

nate: Published canary as `1.8.0-canary.20260321`. I updated the release notes draft to include migration steps and examples. Snippet for pinned installs: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.7.4` or `npm i @redwood/sdk@1.7.4`. Also added a short code example for replacing sync->async client.

jess: Ok launching now. deploy-bot, kick the canary rollout when ready. I'll be on watch and will update the thread. :eyes:

deploy-bot: rolling out canary -> shadowing + 10% traffic in us-west-2. smoke-tests passed in staging. Will post periodic updates here.

deploy-bot: 30m check-in: no regressions observed, error-rate 0.02%, median latency +8ms. Advancing to 30% traffic.

jess: Nice. If we stay green for 2 hours we'll prepare GA cut and merge the deprecation note into docs. Sam, nate — please hold the stable pin for 48h after GA as discussed.

sam: Roger. I'll update release checklist and add the dist-tag manual flip step behind a gating checkbox.

docs-bot: Release notes updated (v1.8.0-canary -> draft). Link: https://git.redwood/docs/releases/1.8.0. Please review before GA.

jess: Thanks everyone. Will follow up with final GA schedule once canary completes the full ramp. If anyone sees anything odd ping me directly. :)
